**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry** in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). 380 commits, 13 user-facing.

Three are breaking. Two hide behind `refactor:` labels, so they were easy to miss.

| Change | Commit |
|---|---|
| `v1` export route dropped | `56dc828` |
| Error types no longer re-exported | 5 commits |
| Expired token now `401`, was `403` | `1d2bd55` |

Two calls to check. I left out perf work since your shape has only three headings. And `docs: note the minimum node version` never touched `engines`, so I did not claim a node bump.
